summary: Shows installing a collection straight from a Git repository and branch with ansible-galaxy using a git+https URL.
questions: Can I install a collection directly from a Git branch?
What's the URL format for installing a collection from GitHub?

answer_card.title: Install a collection from Git
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
ansible-galaxy collection install git+https://github.com/org/repo.git,devel
```
The part after the comma is the branch.
